A new, bigger launcher. A quick tour in a few bubbles: you can skip it at any time (Esc) and see it again from Settings.
The name the other players see above your character and in the lobby.
STEAM: the easiest, you invite your Steam friends, no port or address. IP / VPN: by address (local network, Radmin, Hamachi…).
Opens a lobby: your friends join it, everyone gets READY, then START launches everyone's game. The lobby's gear holds its options.
Enters a friend's lobby (through Steam: their invite, or their lobby found by itself; by IP: their address just above).
The vanilla game: MWCoop isn't loaded at all (no badge, no co-op menu). Your save is never touched by other people's games.
The lobby, your character, what you share and the updates: one click, no window popping over.
Your full look (build, hat, glasses, hair, face, top, pants) in 3D, and your CORRIS color.
What you send to your guests: CDs, paint, flag, posters… and your MSCLoader mods (experimental), copied apart on their side.
Sorted into categories you expand: shadows, distance, detail, textures, frame rate… and now player names (distance, or hidden). One-click presets; in game: F10 menu.
What changes in each version. When a new version is out, an \"Update\" button shows up under the logo: the update happens when you click it.
Every session now keeps its own logs, sorted by date: expand the one that went wrong, zip it or delete old ones. A red \"!\" shows if the last game stopped abruptly.
Also up here now. Making mods? What MWCoop's API does, an example to copy, the DLL and the docs on GitHub.
Updates, theme, language, port, game folder, a host's files at a friend's… and this guide.
Dark or light, French or English, in one click.
The MWCoop community: help, bug reports, news and players to team up with. GitHub and Ko-fi right next to it.
In the Mods tab: OFFICIAL (the one installed in the game) or MWCOOP (installed apart, the game is not changed). If your mods don't load, try MWCOOP, or REINSTALL.
In Settings > Game: Copy (default), Game folder or Steam. If MWCoop doesn't load, try one then the other; the launcher also switches to the game folder by itself.
In Settings > About: removes all of MWCoop (folders included) and MWCoop's MSCLoader, to the Recycle Bin. Your save, your mods and the official MSCLoader stay.
The star at the top: the people who give something to make MWCoop better. Thanks to Dom for 155 outfits, in the Outfit tab!
In Logs: if MWCoop doesn't load, turn it on, start your game, then create the zip. It records everything the launcher does and what the game really loaded.
In Settings > Game. After a crash, Windows sometimes adds a compatibility mode to the game, and MWCoop stops loading: the launcher removes it before every game.
Everything to play trouble-free, sorted into categories you expand: install, host, join, share your mods, Copy / Folder / Steam… and fixes for common problems, with pictures.
In Game options > Keys: click a pill then press the key you want. Chat (T), wallet to give money to others (N), voice (V).

Your own face, top or pants: pick the zone (Head, Torso, Legs), Template opens the game's image with its seams, paint over it, then import. \"Custom face\", \"Custom top\", \"Custom pants\" in the list; others see it in game.
In Car: besides the color, the CORRIS trim (L, LX, SLX, GT) for a new game. The host gives it to their guests.
Graphics and co-op options sorted by type: Voice, Faces, Game and sharing (host's files, starting money), Keys. The groups of this bar fold with a click on their title.

The host can allow cheats (Game options > Game and sharing). In game: panel (F7, set in Keys) or chat commands (/help): go to a player, places, money, heal, time, snow. Every cheat is announced to everyone.
In game, M (set in Game options > Keys) opens the map: the other players live, places, wheel to zoom, drag to move.
In game, F5 (set in Game options > Keys) switches to third person: your character seen from behind on foot, your vehicle seen from behind while driving. Aiming and picking up work as usual.
Three blocks: Co-op, the game's video options, then MWCoop's enhanced ones. Each category has its icon. Unity's configuration window is now skipped: set your screen here.
In game, F8: your camera becomes a small drone to take photos (viewfinder, zoom, tilt, flash). Keys are set in Game options > Drone camera.
Two new presets: Vanilla brings back the original game options, RT turns on ray-traced sun shadows (DXR-capable graphics card, in development). Its settings: Ray tracing category.
In Car, under the trim: the CORRIS options for a new game (year, engine, gearbox, windshield, vinyl roof, wheels, radio...), like the game's plate. The host gives them to their guests.
In Car, at the top of the preview: your own paint on the CORRIS, painted on the game's template. In game, buy \"Custom paint made by artist\" at Fleetari's; the host sends it to their guests.
Turn a mod on or off
In Mods, each mod's \"On\" switch: off, the mod is no longer loaded at all (its DLL becomes .dll.off) nor sent to guests. Back on, it returns at the next launch.
Have fun together in Finland. And if something goes wrong: the logs, and the Discord.
